Use source and generated counts.
n_hat_a(v) = n_src_a(v) + n_gen_a(v)
P_i,a = -lambda n_hat_a(v_i,a) / sum_v n_hat_a(v)
Downweight values already supplied by generated repair data.

div.div:
Maintain class coverage during selection.
C_c^(k) = w (t - n_c^(k)) / t
s_tilde_i^(k) = sum_a(R_i,a + P_i,a) + C_c^(k)
At each step, choose the highest adjusted score.
